scope: Unplaced DE demonstration only. Never use these PSTs/DSNs on HI b019, newdefault stack trial or routed user boards.
preconditions: New output dir must be created under JK/eco/DE_REPLAY_ONLY; no overwrite of source_inputs or oldflow.
Copy source_inputs/DE_BASELINE.brd to DE_REPLAY_ONLY/DE_BASELINE_WORKING.brd before any native tool.
Task-local TEMP/TMP/ALLEGRO_PCBENV/cwd/runtime/logs all under outputRoot. No globalHOME edits.
Use copied private library directory for psmpath/padpath; no source public library mutation.
Historical scripts copied as evidence only: their relativeROOT, CLI and library assumptions must be adapted explicitly, not blindly launched.

flagSemantics.-e: Missing footprint is an error; this is not an ECO enable flag.
flagSemantics.-n: Create a new board during logic import; DO NOT use for applying ECO to copied existing baseline.
flagSemantics.-d: Disables DRC; not part of historical replay command and not proposed here.

plannedCommands.method: Use task-local copy of de_board_read.il and Allegro -readonly to export fresh native80/272/69/placed0 before ECO.
Export actual component values/package and every272pin-net after native save/close/reopen.

optionalRegeneratePST.restriction: Only another copy under outputRoot; PST packaging can rewrite workingDSN bytes. Never modify authored source_inputs DSNs.

optionalFeedback: Historical genfeedformat.exe and pstswp.exe -swp launch vectors are copied. If replaying reverse output, adapt to new output and record actualSWP. Generating SWP is distinct from CaptureGUI applying it.
acceptance: Native completed exit0 + saved marker is necessary but not sufficient.
Fresh baseline and ECO80component/272pin/69net/6NC and placed0; no additions/removals/package changes.
ExactlyR19/R20 VALUE2.2k->3.3k and exactlyJ13.7/8 PB8/PB9 exchange. Every otherpin-net/value unchanged.
No unexpected reverseSWP deltas if feedback replay included; GUIapply remains separate unless actually observed.
All source_input bytes/source originals unchanged after replay.
Report this as controlled ECO reproducibility exercise, not routed manufacturing/HI completion.
